quotes.text: I tried to load the release notes for Tor, on Tor's website, through Tor, and received a 403 error because Tor blocks Tor. Not a good sign.
quotes.author: cowlevel
quotes.source: Hacker News — Tor Project Issues Rapid-Response DoS-Defense Fix
